applies_to: condensed organic aerosol constituent, c_condensed inventory (SS3.4/SS4.3). Domain (owner wording, 2026-08-05): 'fresh, dry, near-source condensed organic aerosol produced by flaming combustion' - NOT 'in-flame' (material hot enough for the reaction zone may not yet be condensed); n~0-1 language belongs to aged/coagulated aerosol.
carrier_note: Draft JSON carrier. Final adoption per FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md SS8 requires re-encoding as a RISE-CBOR64-v1 byte string; the adopted record ID is SHA-256 of those exact CBOR bytes. The draft_record_id here covers only this JSON payload.

computed_outputs_full_mie.method: Bohren-Huffman Mie, pure-Python impl validated vs BH m=1.55 x=5.213 (Qext 3.10500 vs 3.10543), Wiscombe x=10 m=1.5+0.1i, and analytic Rayleigh limit; 80-bin lognormal quadrature

table_metadata.applicability: fresh, dry, near-source condensed organic aerosol produced by flaming combustion (owner domain wording, 2026-08-05)
table_metadata.provenance: computed via validated Bohren-Huffman Mie over the mie_inputs (each input carries its own citation envelope)

uncertainty.basis: sensitivity block of this record; inputs' own uncertainties in mie_inputs
uncertainty.magnitude: k_ext(550) spread 3.27-4.97 m2/g over the recorded size/index corners (~+/-20%); omega(550) 0.964-0.988 over k550 in [0.002,0.006]; g tracks size corners 0.58-0.65

conflicts_flagged: Computed extinction Angstrom exponent 1.78 vs design SS4.3 droplet-regime prose 'n ~ 0-1, weakly chromatic': the cited FRESH size distributions (CMD 0.12um, VMD 0.26um) are smaller than the '0.1-1um dominant mass' picture; n~0-1 applies to AGED/coagulated smoke. The preset must state its fresh-smoke applicability; an aged variant would need a separate size distribution.
Chen & Bond validated only ~300-550nm; >550nm k is extrapolated (their own linear extrapolation labelled non-physical). Visible-red k rests on Sumlin's peat-BrC flatness claim.
gaps: IR absorption for SS3.5 Kirchhoff emission: no verified dataset in hand for condensed organics beyond 780nm (Sumlin extends to 1047nm only; owner decision on IR closure needed)
Sumlin per-wavelength SI tables: hosted with the PAYWALLED Elsevier version - owner library pull
SVOC-corrected alpha/rho(lambda): Chen & Bond Fig.11 is figure-only; digitization required if adopted
derivative enclosures: generate at freeze time

ir_closure.basis: Sumlin measured 375-1047nm only, on smoldering peat BrC - not a mid-IR fresh-flaming surrogate; at condensed-organic temperatures much of the Planck power lies several um into the IR where molecular vibrational absorption can dominate
ir_closure.behavior: predictive runs with nonzero condensed-organic yield FAIL with the reason code; preview continues
closure_paths: composition-appropriate MEASURED mid-IR optical-constant or mass-absorption record
conservative bound proving condensed-organic thermal cooling negligible over the certified state domain
prohibited_shortcuts: silent reuse of the visible power law

brown_carbon_AAE.applicability: wood-combustion organic carbon absorption Angstrom exponent; informs the k(lambda) model below 532nm; NOT the extinction exponent of the computed table

provenance.locator: SS3.5 p.1782, Table 1 p.1776 (methanol extracts, R2 0.989-1.000; decreases with generation T: 11.4@210C -> 6.9@360C)

density_g_cm3.source: Reid 2005 II p.803 (POM ~80% of fresh smoke mass; Turpin & Lim 2001 ~1.2 for organics - cited second-hand through Reid, primary paywalled)

k_imag_400nm.source: Chen & Bond 2010 ACP 10:1773 Table 1 p.1776 (alpha/rho methanol extracts converted at rho=1.2: 210C->0.005-0.017, 270C->0.015-0.028, 360C->0.034-0.041). NOTE title is 'wood combustion' not 'wood pyrolysis'

k_imag_550nm.source: Sumlin et al. 2018 JQSRT 206:392 (arXiv:1712.05028) Fig.3 (kappa ~0.002 flat >=532nm, peat BrC); Chakrabarty et al. 2010 ACP 10:6363 Table 1 (tar balls 0.006 @532); P8 CLOSED 2026-08-06: Sumlin SI Tables S1-S9 recovered from the arXiv PDF itself (PyMieScatt contains no copy) - 55 rows of n, kappa, SSA with 1-sigma uncertainties at 375/405/532/1047nm extracted to docs/data/source_pulls/p8_sumlin_2018_complex_refractive_index.csv. Red end now TABLE-VERIFIED through 1047nm; the measured plateau must NOT be extrapolated further into the IR without explicit model uncertainty (ir_closure block stands)

mie_inputs.k_lambda_model: power law between anchors below 532nm (AAE-consistent, exponent ~5.05); flat 0.004 above 532nm per Sumlin

n_real.source: Reid et al. 2005 ACP 5:827 (Part III) SS3 p.837 (organic shell; Mulholland 1985 smoldering cellulose 1.5; closure studies 1.42-1.55)

size_distribution.source: Reid et al. 2005 ACP 5:799 (Part II) SS3 p.801, Tables 1 p.802 & 7 p.816 (fresh flaming; VMD ~0.26um cross-check)

out_of_domain_policy: NO preview extrapolation rule is named for this record. The computed table's certified domain is [380, 780] nm; out-of-domain lookups REJECT in both predictive and preview modes. The IR gap is governed by the ir_closure block (predictive reason code condensed_organics_ir_unclosed), which is a closure requirement on SS3.5 use - NOT an extrapolation permission; nothing in this policy softens it.

alpha_s_550.note: pure-organic slightly above whole-smoke (BC lowers mixture) - consistent direction; Reid III Table 5 p.843

omega_550.note: fresh flaming WHOLE-smoke omega 0.74-0.85 (Reid III p.834) includes BC; constituent split assigns that absorption to the carbon record
